title: Case of the Golden Idol is half-off on mobile, and now on Google Play Pass!
summary: It's an exciting day for fans of Case of the Golden Idol, as the hit historical mystery puzzler celebrates four years since its launch! Case of the Golden Idol should need little introduction, but for those of you dipping your toes in for the first time, here's a brief overview. Following the titular cursed artefact across decades of crimes in the 18th century, you work to investigate mysterious deaths surrounding the Golden Idol, using its distinctive 'fill in the blanks' deduction system. ... title: Absolum debuts new mobile gameplay trailer with look at customisable controls
summary: While Golden Axe may be the name on everyone's lips with its new animated series, if you fancy less self-referential humour and more proper side-scrolling action, Absolum might be what you're after. Now, you can get a look at Absolum's mobile controls in detail with the latest gameplay reveal trailer! The most interesting thing that fans of Absolum, and newcomers alike, will be glad to see is the amount of customisability on offer. Being a fast-paced modern beat 'em up, you want a great degree of control over your character, so it's no surprise that's what Absolum is offering with fully customisable control placement. ... title: Clash Royale is the next Supercell hit to come to tabletop, with an upcoming Kickstarter project
summary: What's old is new again, and nowadays the humble board game has become something of a staple. Heck, even the biggest developers on the planet are getting in on it! Because Supercell, not satisfied with bringing Clash of Clans to players worldwide, are also set to launch a new Kickstarter for a Clash Royale board game later this year! Clash Royale: The Grand Arena sees Supercell once again teaming up with Maestro Media, the company that also helped bring Clash of Clans: The Epic Raid to kitchen tables worldwide. The Grand Arena looks to adapt the tower defence gameplay from the original, with two lanes and expanding decks of characters and upgrades as players compete to outsmart one another. ... [MORE]

title: Nominations for the Pocket Gamer Awards 2027 Are Now Open!
summary: Whether your a regular reader or find your way to our pages infrequently, there's a high chance that you've been dining on some of the finest mobile games ever released over this past year. It has been, as we say every year, one of the best years for mobile gaming ever. Well, now is the time for you to make you voice heard and to celebrate and champion the games that have filled your spare moments over the year because the Nominations stage of the Pocket Gamer Awards 2027 are now open!It's our thirteenth year running these fantastic awards, and every year it gets tougher and tougher to pick out the cream of the crop, so we're looking to you - dear readers - to nominate your favourite games, developers, characters and more. You know the story... the plucky hero is down on their luck with nowhere to turn and suddenly they remember their past experiences and turn the tide, becoming a champion as they overcome all the odds. Well, now's your time to become a champion - a champion for the mobile games (and more) that have brought you joy over the year. But, don't worry, you won't need to swipe a glaive at a hydra's throat, or gut a goblin with a swift swipe of a scimitar (at least, not this year), here you'll be playing champion by making your voice heard and filling out a nice little form that you can find over on our nominations page. ... [MORE]

title: Xbox announces new Nano Controller that's also compatible with mobile
summary: Xbox have announced their latest peripheral, and in a break from the norm, it's going smaller rather than bigger. The Xbox Nano Controller has opened pre-orders and will debut later this year, becoming the smallest Xbox controller yet, with some other surprising features. The Xbox Nano Controller is their smallest, full-fledged controller yet. It features all the same inputs you've come to expect, as well as a reprogrammable action button. And, rather interestingly, it's also fully compatible with mobile! It's both that compatibility and the deal they're offering that makes this such an interesting product. ... [MORE]

summary: As we head towards the weekend, you may already be deciding what you're going to dip your toes into. And you're already spoilt for choice, but it might well be worth taking a second glance because Sifu, the critically acclaimed martial-arts brawler, is available now on iOS and Android! title: Bobara brings a weather-watching capybara to your iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch
summary: Somewhere along the way we agreed that capybaras are the most relaxed animals going, and I’ve never seen a good reason to argue. Some Japanese zoos even run them hot baths in winter. They just sit in there, eyes half shut, while the rest of the world carries on without them. Bobara puts one of them in your pocket, and it’s on its way to the App Store next month. It’s a small app about Momo, a capybara who lives in an onsen across your iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch, with an Apple TV version that fills the big screen and reads his collection over iCloud. ... [MORE]

title: Thrifty Business has you running your own 90s-inspired thrift store, coming soon to mobile
summary: We've had farms, we've had supermarkets, and now the latest cosy simulator to arrive on mobile puts you in the role of a charity shop owner! Sorry, thrift shop owner, as there's a difference, believe it or not. But in Thrifty Business the objective is the same as it always is: make money and keep your customers happy. title: Titanium Court is a quirky mix of match-3 with grid-based strategy, and it's all a bit strange in a good way
summary: Time to put on your thinking cap and get your media literacy degree, because there's a surreal new game coming to mobile this month. AP Thomson's wacky, strange and esoteric grid-based strategy, puzzler, mystery, point-and-click thing Titanium Court lands on mobile October 29th! And it's somehow easier to describe what it isn't rather than what it is, but I'll try anyway. Titanium Court is made intentionally difficult to describe, but at its core seems to be a combination of match-three, roguelike and real-time strategy where you manipulate the terrain of a world to gather resources, recruit soldiers and destroy your enemy. Of course, in between all that will be interludes, mysteries and oddities that suggest something more happening beneath the surface. ... [MORE]

title: Beyond Words puts a Balatro-style spin on Scrabble, now on iOS
summary: It would seem that the constantly growing subgenre of Balatro-like games isn't slowing anytime soon. Beyond Words takes yet another tabletop classic and puts a roguelike spin on it. But with a pedigree including two of the minds behind hits such as GoldenEye 64 and TimeSplitters, it's well worth a look! In case you hadn't already guessed, Beyond Words: A Word Roguelike takes the classic tabletop pastime of Scrabble and adds in many of the elements Balatro helped popularise. You'll be tasked with making longer and more complex words, meeting ever higher score requirements, and making use of modifiers and upgrades to continue growing your multiplier! ... [MORE]

title: Walk the Frog, the Post-it note puzzler, launches for iOS and Android
summary: Walk the Frog, the Post-it Note puzzler from the developer of the same name, is out now on iOS and Android. Seeing you guiding the humble Froggog back home in time to meet up with his friend Buddy and attend the Froggapalooza festival. title: Royal Cooking serves up 50 million downloads without a royal in sight
summary: Every town seems to have a restaurant called the Royal something, and I’d bet very few of them have ever had an actual royal through the door. Royal Cooking keeps that tradition going nicely. No palace kitchen, no monarch sending the soup back, just a lot of restaurants and hungry customers, and by now more than 50 million downloads of it. If you’ve run a kitchen in any time management sim before, Matryoshka Games won’t surprise you much. Orders come in, you cook and serve them, and the coins go back into better equipment and nicer ingredients so the next shift runs a bit quicker than the last one. You can shuffle the kitchen layout around as well, to get the stations where you want them before the queues start backing up. ... [MORE]

title: Monopoly Go returns to McDonald’s with free shields and a mountain of dice
summary: McDonald’s has been sticking Monopoly pieces on its packaging since the late 80s, and at this point the two go together about as naturally as fries and salt. So, no great shock that Monopoly Go is back at the counter for a second year, tagging along with the McDonald’s Monopoly promotion in the US. You peel the game piece off eligible packaging and scan it in the McDonald’s app, and that gets you a shot at mobile prizes alongside the usual food ones. You’ll need to have signed up for the promotion in the app first, mind. The big prize is $100,000 towards gold bars, with up to two winners. Below that, 10,000 bundles of 5,300 dice rolls are being handed out. That’s a lot of dice. ... [MORE]

A decade is a fairly long time for an import. It launched in mainland China in May 2016 and has done very well for itself there since, while the rest of us looked on from outside. I’ve had takeaway orders take a scenic route before, but nothing like that. ... [MORE]

title: Brotato's Primal Dread DLC now has a release date, but you'll be waiting a bit for mobile
summary: It seems like it's been months since we heard about Brotato's latest DLC, Primal Dread. And that's because it was last heard being announced all the way back in April of this year. But, fortunately, we now have a release date, although you'll still be waiting a while for it on mobile! While it may be a bit of a wait, Brotato's Primal Dread DLC comes jam-packed with new content to enjoy. There's a host of new weapons and characters, as well as a massive primordial-themed map to explore and bosses to challenge, including a skyscraper-sized kaiju that you can only see the legs of! It's certainly got size going for it, if nothing else. ... [MORE]

title: Replaced sees the dystopian cyberpunk platformer making its way to Android
summary: It's a bit of a trite observation, but sometimes it really feels as if we're living in a cyberpunk dystopia, just without the cool stuff. Fortunately, if you're hankering for a neon-soaked world to explore, then you're in luck, because 2.5D cinematic platformer Replaced is set to make its way to Android on December 9th! Set in an alternate-universe 1980s America, you play as R.E.A.C.H., an AI that's been unexpectedly placed into a human body. You'll explore the sprawling metropolis of Phoenix City and do battle with the sinister Phoenix Corporation in your typical dour cyberpunk urban hellscape where human life is cheap. ... [MORE]

title: Azur Promilia set to launch first English-language beta in 2027 after 20 million pre-registrations
summary: Azur Promilia, the upcoming fantasy ARPG from developer Manjuu Games, is set to launch its first English-language beta in summer 2027, it has been announced. The news comes alongside a massive 20-million pre-registration milestone and their first English promo video. Azur Promilia is set in a fantasy world populated by both humans and creatures called Kibo. Alongside the usual fantasy ARPG adventure, you'll also be able to befriend and recruit Kibos, using their distinctive abilities to help you out in both exploration and combat. All this, and both the distinctive anime-inspired character designs that Manjuu are well known for. ... [MORE]

title: Candy Crush sees the return of the Jellynauts in its new Spooky Season
summary: Being one of, if not the, most popular puzzle games on the planet, it should be no surprise that Candy Crush is getting in on the Halloween spirit. And with the most terrifying month of the year now thoroughly underway, Spooky Season is upon us as the evil Jellynauts make a return to Candy Crush Saga. This year's event, running until November 8th, sees the Jellynauts once more invade Candy Town. You'll be tasked with diving into the Spooky Season Expedition and saving the various trapped inhabitants before making your way to save Mr Toffee, who'll help you put an end to the Jellynaut menace once and for all. ... [MORE]
